semantic_dependency_checks.chain: Analytic appendix → multiplier ideals and modifications
semantic_dependency_checks.finding: Weierstrass preparation uses Q01 holomorphic calculus. Noetherianity and coherence proceed by dimension induction within A01. Connected fibers and divisor realization have internal proofs; realization uses only the two accepted resolution/principalization existence interfaces and earlier A01 tools. The printed appendix position creates no dependency on its Q05 consumers.

semantic_dependency_checks.chain: Big-class relative equations → positive mass implies bigness
semantic_dependency_checks.finding: Q09 first proves big implies positive volume, without its converse. Relative variational/capacity equations assume an already big class. The converse enlarges a pseudo-effective class by epsilon omega, which is big directly by the definition, then obtains a uniform strict dual bound. Neither SGPT nor the pending converse is an equation-existence input.

semantic_dependency_checks.chain: Positive-mass envelopes and bounded-density equations → arbitrary/zero-mass ceiling identity
semantic_dependency_checks.finding: The positive-mass perturbations obtain prescribed measures from the preceding internal theorem. The finite mixed-measure expansion supplies a normalized tail bound independent of the diminishing mass. The limit identifies the envelope before proving the ceiling equality and idempotence. The theorem being proved is not an input to its limit lemma.
